summary_text: Q1 2026 results: revenue ~$831M (beat by 13%), net income ~$134M, Adj EBITDA ~$326M; EPS $1.29 missed by 15%. Stock up 14.6% Wednesday hitting $281.74; +13% to $244 in week since Q1 results. Revolving credit facility extended, commitments raised to ~$2.025B. Quarterly dividend raised to $0.45/share (record May 13, paid May 26). Aerospace Products: 270 CFM56 modules serviced in Q1, nearly double YoY; Lisbon and Rome facilities still ramping.
